messages.subject: problem with Igraph
parts:
Hi,

Deploying a fully-fonctionning app in a local environnement ro Shinyapps.io, i get the following error message :

Warning in install.packages("igraph") : 'lib = "/usr/local/lib/R/site-library"' is not writable

The problem seems to be due to igraph installing. It's the first time that it occurs to me, since I have other functionning applications which are using Igraph in the same shinyapps.io account.

Best regards.

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: problem with Igraph
parts:

http://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/getting-started.html#using-your-r-packages-in-the-cloud

messages.author: 8899033a1963ffa1
messages.subject: Re: problem with Igraph
parts:
Same here. I did a try with the simplest Rmarkdown/Shiny

---
title: "Untitled"
author: "RP"
date: "April 27, 2018"
output: html_document
runtime: shiny
---

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(igraph)
library(shiny)
actors <- data.frame(name=c("Alice", "Bob", "Cecil", "David",
                            "Esmeralda"),
                     age=c(48,33,45,34,21),
                     gender=c("F","M","F","M","F"))
relations <- data.frame(from=c("Bob", "Cecil", "Cecil", "David",
                               "David", "Esmeralda"),
                        to=c("Alice", "Bob", "Alice", "Alice", "Bob", "Alice"),
                        same.dept=c(FALSE,FALSE,TRUE,FALSE,FALSE,TRUE),
                        friendship=c(4,5,5,2,1,1), advice=c(4,5,5,4,2,3))

renderPlot({
  g <- graph_from_data_frame(relations, directed=TRUE, vertices=actors)
  plot(g)
})
```


And got an error when deployed on the Shinyapp.io server.


2018-04-27T16:06:31.240996+00:00 shinyapps[332171]:   libglpk.so.36: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
